annotations.title: Fetch full texts or screen them

description: Use this when the researcher wants open-access full texts retrieved (action fetch, no AI) or full-text screening run by AI (action run), or a full-text decision recorded (action decide: only one the researcher states for a named study, never your own; confirm study and reason first; logged as from this chat). Undecided studies: give the human_review link. fetch and run default to dry_run true. Full-text screening is paid and needs the screening stages approved.

dry_run.description: Default true: only report what would run and the quota used. false launches.

idempotency_key.description: Same key within 24 h returns the first launch instead of a second job.
